result.description:
## ICT Support and Test Engineers (nec)
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented ICT Support and Test Engineer to join our team and play a key role in maintaining the integrity, performance, and quality of our systems and infrastructure. This role combines technical support, quality assurance, and systems testing to ensure seamless operations and adherence to established standards. The ideal candidate brings a methodical approach to problem-solving, strong communication skills, and a solid foundation in ICT systems and environments. This position suits an experienced professional who thrives in a collaborative setting and is committed to delivering high-quality technical outcomes.
## Key Responsibilities
- Schedule and conduct quality audit inspections across systems, data, and documentation, identifying variations and potential high-risk areas to ensure continued adherence to established standards and procedures.
- Investigate, diagnose, and resolve system problems and performance issues, providing hands-on troubleshooting support for desktops, hardware, software, printers, databases, operating systems, email platforms, and network connectivity.
- Test the functionality, behaviour, and integrity of systems and application code within defined testing protocols and quality frameworks, identifying and documenting errors, faults, and deviations from specification.
- Develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance processes, guidelines, and strategies to support system reliability, security, and performance across the organisation.
- Recommend and facilitate corrective action plans to address non-compliance issues identified through ongoing monitoring, auditing, and review of operational processes and procedures.
- Perform organisational systems architecture reviews and assessments, providing well-informed recommendations on current and future hardware and software strategies aligned with business needs.
- Develop and deliver technical guidance, training, and support to end users and stakeholders on application software, operational procedures, and best practice usage.
- Communicate and liaise effectively with users and management to promote awareness of quality control standards, data integrity requirements, and ICT compliance obligations.
- Create, review, and maintain comprehensive technical documentation including procedural guides, operational manuals, technical specifications, testing reports, and maintenance inventory records.
- Assist in the planning and execution of system upgrades, installations, configurations, and patch management activities to minimise disruption and maintain system availability.
- Monitor and evaluate system infrastructure to proactively identify risks and opportunities for improvement, contributing to the ongoing optimisation of ICT environments.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and project stakeholders to support the delivery of ICT initiatives and ensure quality outcomes are achieved throughout the project lifecycle.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline; or equivalent demonstrated experience in a similar ICT role.
- Proven experience in ICT technical support, systems testing, or quality assurance within a professional environment.
- Strong understanding of testing methodologies, quality assurance frameworks, and audit processes across systems and software.
- Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across a broad range of ICT systems, including hardware, software, operating systems, and network components.
- Experience developing and maintaining technical documentation such as test plans, procedural guides, specifications, and operational manuals.
- Solid knowledge of database management, system security, backup procedures, and infrastructure performance monitoring.
- Proficiency in diagnosing software and hardware faults and delivering appropriate solutions within agreed timeframes and service levels.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured, methodical approach to quality assurance and issue resolution.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team, managing competing priorities and deadlines effectively.
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as ITIL Foundation, CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, ISTQB (Software Testing), or Microsoft Certified qualifications.
- Experience with enterprise-level systems, cloud platforms, or virtualisation technologies such as AWS, Azure, or VMware.
- Familiarity with IT service management (ITSM) tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or Zendesk.
- Exposure to Agile or DevOps delivery environments and associated testing practices such as continuous integration and automated testing.
- Previous experience conducting formal ICT audits, architecture reviews, or compliance assessments.
- Knowledge of relevant Australian and international ICT standards and frameworks, including ISO/IEC 27001 or COBIT.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth.
- Access ongoing learning and development opportunities, including support for professional certifications and industry training.
- Enjoy a flexible work environment with options for hybrid working arrangements to support work-life balance.
- Contribute to meaningful, large-scale ICT projects that have a real impact on organisational performance and service delivery.
- Competitive salary package with opportunities for career progression within a growing and dynamic technology function.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Engaged Finance is a growing mortgage brokerage based in Melbourne's inner west. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional advice, outstanding customer service and creating long-term relationships with our clients.

We're looking for a motivated Mortgage Broker who is hungry to grow their career and become a key part of our business.

As a Mortgage Broker at Engaged Finance, you'll work with a steady flow of business-generated leads while also proactively building your own referral network and client relationships. You'll be responsible for managing clients throughout the entire lending journey, from the initial enquiry through to settlement and beyond.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Meeting with clients to understand their financial goals and borrowing needs.
- Recommending suitable lending solutions from our panel of lenders.
- Converting business-generated leads into settled home loans.
- Prospecting and developing relationships with referral partners to generate new business.
- Preparing and submitting loan applications.
- Liaising with lenders, solicitors, conveyancers and other stakeholders.
- Working closely with our loan processing team to ensure a seamless client experience.
- Providing exceptional customer service and ongoing support to clients.
- Maintaining accurate client records and CRM updates.
- Achieving monthly settlement and activity targets.

What We Offer

- Competitive Base Salary + Commission + Superannuation
- Unlimited leads provided by the business
- Vibrant, young and supportive office environment
- Dedicated loan processing support
- Modern office located in Yarraville
- Genuine career growth opportunities

This role is ideal for a motivated broker who enjoys helping clients, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and wants to maximise their earning potential while working within a supportive and energetic team.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Requisition Number: REQ677555
Employment Type: Temporary Part - Time (until 30 June 2027)
Position Classification: Registered Nurse
Remuneration: $81,748.17 - $114,771.98 per annum, pro rata (+ super + 17.5% leave loading where applicable)
Hours per Week: Up to 27 
Applications Close: 5 August 2026
Vaccination Category: A 
Located in: Site negotiable within MLHD

Supporting Dignity, Independence and Wellbeing.

About the Opportunity
Are you a compassionate and community-focused Registered Nurse seeking a rewarding role in Continence Care?
MLHD are offering a motivated Registered Nurse the chance to apply there skills across Griffith, Hay, Hillston, Lake Cargelligo, Leeton, Barham, Deniliquin, Finley, Jerilderie, Mathoura, Moama, Moulamein, Tooleybuc and surrounds of MLHD, in Continence care

As the Registered Nurse, you will:
Provide comprehensive, coordinated and person-centred nursing care to individuals and families within their homes and community settings. Provide a client goal focused service to empower them to achieve their health goals
Delivering broad knowledge, education and care in everything in continence
You will work collaboratively with consumers, carers, General Practitioners and multidisciplinary teams to ensure continuity of care and optimal health outcomes.

To find out more, please review the Position Description

About You

Our ideal candidate will demonstrate:

Registration as a Registered Nurse with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia via AHPRA

Experience or interest in community nursing, including chronic disease management and post-acute care

Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build therapeutic relationships with individuals, families, carers and multidisciplinary teams

Ability to conduct comprehensive assessments, develop and evaluate person-centred care plans, and deliver safe, evidence-based nursing care in community and home-based settings

Why join MLHD

At Murrumbidgee Local Health District (MLHD), we offer more than a job, we offer the chance to make a real difference.

Make a Meaningful Impact - Play a vital role in delivering essential health services to our diverse and vibrant regional communities.

Attractive Remuneration - Enjoy competitive pay aligned with your skills and experience.

Generous Salary Packaging - Access up to $20,600 per annum tax-free for living expenses, plus the option for novated car leasing.

Professional Development - Take advantage of ongoing learning and career advancement opportunities.

Health & Wellbeing Support - Benefit from our comprehensive wellness programs for you and your family, including Employee Assistance Programs, Fitness Passport, and initiatives to support both physical and mental health.

Click here to discover why MLHD is the right place to grow your career and contribute to healthier communities.

How to Apply

If this sounds like the opportunity for you, click apply now! Please contact Contact Stephanie Krause, Nurse Manager on Stephanie.Krause@health.nsw.gov.au , if you have any questions about this role.

MLHD welcomes applications from people of all backgrounds and is committed to building a workforce that reflects the communities we serve.
We encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, people with disability, people from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds and the LGBTIQ+ community.

If you identify as Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander, you can access recruitment application support through the Stepping Up initiative.

This is a NSW Health Category A position which requires immunisation and screening for certain diseases. The full list of requirements are outlined in the NSW Health OASV Policy (Page 11). You will be required to complete the OASV Undertaking- Declaration Form and TB Assessment Tool during the recruitment process. Please upload this with your application along with any other vaccination evidence that you may have.
